CHAPTER.VERS: Unless the builds the house,those who build it labour in vain.Unless the guards the city,the watchman wakes in vain.
In vain you rise early,and finish so late,and so eat sorrow’s bread;for he cares for his loved onesin their sleep.
Children are a gift of the ,the fruit of the womb, a reward.
Like arrows, by warriors wielded,are the children of youth.
Happy the man who has filledhis quiver full of them.He shall not be ashamed when he speakswith enemies in the gate.
